actions.detail: Preflight and WorkPreflight froze DDL -> constraints -> repos -> transaction -> concurrency tests; formal P03-001 review remains pending while the local dependency projection is valid.
Added the isolated agent_runtime schema migration, typed SQLAlchemy models, session-bound repositories, real PostgreSQL integration tests, and Harness 25 S/I/D tests.
Inspector table inventory was incorrectly asserted in physical catalog order; sorted set comparison repaired the test without changing DDL.
pg8000 wraps a commit-time 23514 constraint rejection as SQLAlchemy DatabaseError; the assertion now verifies the stable database error without depending on a narrower driver subclass.
Eight P03-002 PostgreSQL tests passed with no failure, error, skip, or xfail.
Generic Verify used BOOT assertions, Security lacked the task allowlist, and RollbackVerify was a placeholder.
Added task-scoped runner adapters for exact runtime, audit, workset, artifact, rollback, and Harness 25 assertions; Catalog bytes remain unchanged.

The full CI gates passed, but a relative ReportRoot was reused after Push-Location and split reports across two directories. ci.ps1 now resolves the absolute report root before changing directories; only the generated wrong-path artifacts are removed before the affected regression rerun.

The repaired CI evidence path contains all ten reports; 148 unit/integration tests, 8 contract tests, lock/frozen sync, format, lint, type, secret, clock-contract, SCA, and license gates passed with mandatory_skip_count=0 and xfail_count=0.
